name: Trespassing
overview: Scripture addresses trespassing as a serious offense requiring both restitution and atonement. When one wrongfully takes or damages another's property, as detailed in Exodus 22:9, the offender must compensate double to the injured party. In cases involving sacred things or sins committed in ignorance, Leviticus outlines a trespass offering—a ram without blemish—accompanied by making full restitution plus an additional fifth part, demonstrating God's provision for forgiveness through sacrificial atonement (Leviticus 5:6, 5:15-16; 6:5-6). These instructions emphasize the holiness of God's standards and the necessity of both justice and mercy in addressing trespass against others and the Lord.
